user.title: LokaleNET account
user.description: Log in with the identifier and password your property administrator gave you. The integration only reads the portal.

data_description.url: Leave the default unless your administrator gave you a different login page.
data_description.username: The identifier you use on the LokaleNET login page.

reconfigure.title: Change the account
reconfigure.description: A new portal address or identifier from your administrator. The entities stay the same.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal no longer accepts the password for {username}.

error.invalid_auth: The portal did not accept the identifier or password.
error.cannot_connect: The portal could not be reached, or it answered with a page that is not its login page (maintenance, or a wrong address).
error.insecure_url: Use an https:// address, the password would otherwise travel unencrypted.
error.invalid_url: Enter only the address of the login page.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this account.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

auth_failed.message: The portal no longer accepts the password.

connection_failed.message: The portal could not be reached: {error}

parse_failed.message: A portal page has changed and could not be read: {error}
